name: Wereraven

source.note: Ravenloft: The Horrors Within's Wereraven (the 2024-era block), read on D&D Beyond (owner's account). The 50 ft fly speed is listed for every form because it takes hybrid form at once; Mimicry is text only.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.summary: Mimics voices and animal sounds; a DC 12 Wisdom (Insight) check spots the imitation.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: Two attacks, Scratch or Shortbow in any mix; one can be a Beak.

actions.name: Beak (Raven or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.summary: A stabbing beak; a Humanoid it hits makes a DC 10 Con save or is cursed: at 0 Hit Points it becomes a wereraven.

bonus_actions.name: Shape-Shift
bonus_actions.summary: Becomes a raven-humanoid hybrid or a Small raven, or returns to its true humanoid form.
bonus_actions.text: The wereraven turns into a raven-humanoid hybrid or a Tiny raven, or back into its human form. Apart from its size, its statistics are the same in every form, except that it flies 50 feet as a raven (walking only 10 feet) or as a hybrid (walking 30 feet) and can't fly in human form. What it wears or carries doesn't change with it. It returns to human form when it dies.

summary: A Keeper of the Feather: crossbow and shortsword as a human, wings and a cursing beak as a hybrid.
